scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir frontend install && cd backend && ./mvnw -q -DskipTests dependency:go-offline
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:deps && concurrently -k -n api,web,agent -c green,cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:agent"
scripts.dev:deps: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio ai-postgres
scripts.test:backend: docker compose up -d postgres && cd backend && ./mvnw test
scripts.stop: docker compose stop postgres redis minio ai-postgres
